steps.note: Open the existing awarded event's summary page; the prepared state already represents an event awarded to Vendor A.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Open the RFQ stage specified by the case.
Open the RFQ Responses tab before accessing Settings.
Open the RFQ Settings menu and choose Recreate Order.
Verify that the Recreate Order window opened.
Verify the duration selector contains the five named choices and the expected nine additional choices.
Verify the Details button is available.
Verify the Clear button is available.
Verify the Edit More Details button is available.
Verify the Cancel button is available.
Verify the Create Order button is available.
